name: codeSelector.
author: marketincode

sections.description:
Generating UI components with AI takes 30 seconds. Editing them inside Elementor used to take 30 minutes.

When you generate a hero section, pricing table, or bento grid in ChatGPT, Claude, v0, Bolt, Lovable, or Cursor, pasting 1,500 lines of raw HTML and CSS into a standard custom HTML widget creates a maintenance nightmare. Finding a single heading to fix a typo or swapping an image URL requires endless Ctrl+F scrolling—and generic AI CSS classes (h1, button, .card, .container) often break your WordPress theme layout.

codeSelector. by Marketincode solves this forever. It is the missing bidirectional Visual-to-Code Bridge built specifically for Elementor designers, developers, and AI builders.

How It Works in 3 Simple Steps

  1. Paste Your AI Code: Drag the codeSelector. widget onto any Elementor page and paste your HTML/CSS snippet.
  2. 1-Click Visual-to-Code Jump: Click any element on the visual canvas—a badge, button, paragraph, or card—and the Ace code editor jumps in < 5 ms to its exact HTML line, highlighting the block. You can also double-click any line in the code editor to scroll the visual preview straight to that element.
  3. Double-Click Live Inline Editing: Double-click any text or image directly on the Elementor preview canvas to rewrite copy in place or select a new photo from the WordPress Media Library. Your changes are automatically encoded and synced back into the exact line of HTML code.

Free Features (Included in WordPress.org Edition)

  • Bidirectional Visual ⟷ Code Sync: Click any visual element to highlight its exact HTML line in Ace Editor, or double-click a code line to locate it visually on the canvas.
  • Live Inline Text Editing (2x Click): Double-click headings, paragraphs, buttons, list items, or badges to edit text directly on screen with exact character caret placement (caretRangeFromPoint) and multiline preservation.
  • 1-Click & 2x-Click Image Replacement: Click any <img> on canvas to open the floating Image Inspector. Pick a replacement photo directly from the WordPress Media Library, paste a custom URL, and edit SEO alt text with instant code synchronization.
  • Enhanced Ace Code Editor: Syntax-highlighted editor with active line pills, automatic scrolling, and real-time preview rendering.
  • 0 KB Frontend Overhead: All bridge scripts and editor styles load exclusively inside the Elementor editor. Your public website visitors receive pure, clean HTML/CSS with zero extra JavaScript or performance penalty on Core Web Vitals.
  • Hardened Native Security (wp_kses): Custom extended whitelist supporting modern HTML5 semantics, SVG icons, Flexbox, CSS Grid, CSS custom properties (--var), clamp(), and calc() while stripping unauthorized scripts, iframes, and XSS event handlers.
  • Multilingual Ready (i18n): Fully localized interface available in English, Spanish (es_ES, es_MX), French (fr_FR), German (de_DE), Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR), and Italian (it_IT).

Pro Features (For Agencies, Freelancers & Power Users)

Unlock the full professional workflow with codeSelector. Pro:

  • Recursive CSS Auto-Scoping: Automatically prefixes all <style> rules under the unique widget container ([data-codeselector-id]), intelligently handling :root, body, html, nested @media queries, @supports, and preserving @keyframes names. Generic AI styles never bleed into your header, footer, or other Elementor sections.
  • Alt + Click Direct CSS Rule Jump: Hold Alt and click any element on the canvas to jump directly to the CSS selector that styles it inside your <style> block.
  • Ctrl / Cmd + Click JavaScript Jump: Hold Ctrl (or Cmd on Mac) and click an interactive element to jump straight to its event listener or animation logic inside <script>.
  • Safe Inline <script> Execution: Enable interactive JavaScript for custom sliders, tabs, accordions, countdowns, and micro-animations (strictly validated against the content author’s unfiltered_html capability while blocking external src scripts).
  • Carousel & Gallery Slide Inspector: Automatically detects multi-slide carousels and image grids, allowing you to switch between hidden slides and replace individual slide images from a unified thumbnail strip.
  • Live Link (href) Editing: When editing a link or button inline, a floating href input appears so you can update destination URLs or anchor tags on the fly.
  • Quick Section Navigator: A smart dropdown in the Elementor panel that indexes your <style> blocks, HTML comments (<!-- 01. Hero -->), <h1>/<h2> headings, and <script> sections for 1-click navigation in large files.

Learn more and see the interactive live demo at marketincode.com/codeselector.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for codeSelector, or upload the codeselector.zip file via Upload Plugin.
  2. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  3. Open any page or template with Elementor (compatible with Elementor Free 3.5+ and Elementor Pro 4.x).
  4. In the Elementor widgets panel, find codeSelector. under the Marketincode category (or search for codeSelector / AI) and drag it onto your canvas.
  5. Click any element in the starter template to test the 1-Click HTML Jump, or double-click any heading to edit text live!
sections.faq:
Does codeSelector. require Elementor Pro?

No! codeSelector. works seamlessly with the free version of Elementor (version 3.5.0 and above) as well as Elementor Pro.

Will this plugin slow down my website or affect Core Web Vitals?

Not at all. The visual-to-code bridge, inline editor, and synchronization scripts are only enqueued inside the Elementor editor screen. On the public frontend, codeSelector. adds 0 KB of JavaScript and 0 extra HTTP requests, rendering only your sanitized HTML and CSS.

Can I use code generated by ChatGPT, Claude, v0, Bolt, or Lovable?

Yes! That is the exact use case codeSelector. was built for. You can paste complete HTML + <style> components generated by any AI assistant and immediately edit text, swap images, and inspect lines visually.

How does CSS Auto-Scoping work in Pro?

AI tools frequently output generic selectors like body, section, .container, or .btn that accidentally override your WordPress theme styles. In codeSelector. Pro, our recursive CSS parser automatically scopes every rule to [data-codeselector-id="..."]—even inside @media queries—while remapping body/html/:root variables to the widget wrapper.

Is it safe against XSS and malicious code?

Yes. All output passes through CodeSelector_Sanitizer::sanitize(), built on WordPress’s native wp_kses() engine. Inline on* event attributes (onclick, onerror), <iframe/object/embed> tags, and external <script src="..."> tags are strictly stripped. In the Pro version, inline <script> blocks only execute if the post author and last editor hold the WordPress unfiltered_html capability.

Which languages are supported?

codeSelector. is fully internationalized (i18n) with English as the base language and ships with complete translations for Spanish (es_ES, es_MX), French (fr_FR), German (de_DE), Portuguese (pt_BR), and Italian (it_IT).

What happens if I deactivate Pro or downgrade to Free?

Your HTML and CSS content remains safely stored in your Elementor page. Pro-only features (such as automatic CSS scoping, inline <script> execution, and Alt+Click CSS jumping) simply deactivate gracefully without deleting your code.

Do you offer a refund guarantee on the Pro version?

Yes. Every codeSelector. Pro license (Monthly, Annual, or Lifetime) is backed by a 14-day 100% money-back guarantee processed securely through Freemius.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Added full internationalization (i18n) across PHP and JavaScript editor bridge (codeselector text domain).
  • Added bundled translations for Spanish (es_ES, es_MX), French (fr_FR), German (de_DE), Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR), and Italian (it_IT).
  • Added master languages/codeselector.pot translation template.
  • Replaced external offloaded placeholder URLs with bundled local SVG assets for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and Elementor 4.x.
  • Removed trialware features and ensured 100% compliance with WordPress.org Guideline 5.
  • Migrated starter code templates to static assets and enqueued styles via native WordPress APIs.

1.4.1

  • Resolved WordPress.org header URI guidelines.
  • Integrated Freemius SDK for seamless Free/Pro licensing.

1.4.0

  • Initial public release of codeSelector. Visual-to-Code Bridge for Elementor.
